title: Extension Fee of a TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours Block
content:
**Fee.** The extension fee of a TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours block is the size's extension fee percentage of the block's hours balance valued at the size's rate per block hour, rounded half up to the cent.

In words: the fee is the block's remaining hours on the day the extension is signed, times the value of an hour, times the fee percentage divided by 100; the rounding to the cent happens once, at the end, on the fee itself. The hours balance is the block's own remaining balance; the fee percentage and the rate per block hour are the figures of the block's size in the TimeBank terms.

## Worked figures (hypothetical balances)

| Size | Hours balance | Rate per block hour | Fee percentage | Fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| TimeBank 20-Hour Block | 12.00 | 158.00 | 10 | 189.60 |
| TimeBank 160-Hour Block | 70.00 | 135.00 | 7.5 | 708.75 |
| TimeBank 320-Hour Block | 33.33 | 128.00 | 7.5 | 319.968, rounded to 319.97 |

A block with a balance of zero carries a fee of 0.00.
